# Ivan Maslev's Portfolio

> > Portfolio of Ivan Maslev, Senior 3D/UI Artist specializing in game art, character sculpting, and environment design using ZBrush, Blender, and Unreal Engine 4.

Ivan Maslev is a game artist with professional experience at Black Sea Games (Knights of Honor II: Sovereign) and Masthead Studios, alongside independent projects. The portfolio showcases 3D modeling, character sculpts, environment scenes, UI/UX design, and indie game development work.

## Key Topics

- Ivan Maslev
